content: {"phoneNote":"The call bar sits at the top under the header (not fixed at bottom) and the hero repeats \"Pokličite\" twice within one screen, while the giant 2004 numeral fills the rest of the first screen.","desktopNote":"A text-only hero with a headline that spans the width and a large empty left half under it, then another dead left column before the 2004 numeral; nothing anchors the eye.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Remove the duplicate 'Pokličite nas' link in the hero (header/bar already carries the call action) and keep a single secondary link to services.","Fill the empty left half of the desktop hero and story section: place the 2004 numeral or a portrait of the director beside the headline instead of leaving dead white bands.","Give the phone hero one deliberate proportion: tighten the gap between text and the 2004 block so the first screen does not end on a half-cropped numeral."],"blockers":[]}
